title: Molesting the Decapitated
desc_lfm_album: The album cover is Joel-Peter Witkin's "Man Without Head" (1993) - a photograph of a real cadaver. The samples placed at the beginning of "Festering Vomitous Mass" and end of "Shroud of Encryption" are both taken from an interview with serial killer Joseph Kallinger. Recording information: Recorded in February 1999 at Gene Coleman's Cave (Dallas, Texas). Ruben Rosas Vocals (lead) Brian Guitars Kevin Clark Guitars, Vocals (backing) Mike Majewski Bass Brad Fincher Drums D. Braxton Vocals (track 3) .
desc_lfm_artist:
Devourment is a slam death metal band that was formed in 1995 after the demise of local Dallas based death metal band Necrocide by drummer Brad Fincher and guitarist Braxton Henry (both from Necrocide) along with vocalist Wayne Knupp.

Wayne decided to move back to his hometown of Chicago, Brad moved to San Antonio, TX to get his education. Months later both Wayne and Brad moved back to the Dallas area and decided to continue the life of the band.
